dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged high-contrast perimeters on prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures; sharp gradient transition from light cream edges to darker interior cores; most distinct in the upper-left and central-dorsal regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, localized high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated along the lower-lateral flank and posterior-dorsal region; clusters lack internal gradients and appear as solid asymmetrical points.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three primary dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle; the vertex of the largest central annulus is positioned dorsally and slightly anterior to the secondary posterior-dorsal cluster.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced area of reddish-brown discoloration on the posterior-lateral flank, contrasting with the primary dark green-toned pelage.
